concerns.text: Task T046 is listed in the 'Notes' section as 'T046 implements the real data streaming requirement...' but no corresponding task entry exists in the task list (T001-T045). This leaves FR-001 (data preparation) and the plan's requirement for handling full SFT dataset size without memory exhaustion unimplemented.

Task T047 is referenced in 'Notes' as ensuring the data loader fails loudly if the source is unavailable, but no task entry exists in the list. This leaves the plan's data hygiene requirement (Constitution Principle III) and FR-001 validation strategy vulnerable to silent failures.

Task T048 is referenced in 'Notes' as validating test/training set distinctness (FR-006), but no task entry exists in the list. This leaves the methodological soundness requirement for independence (FR-006) unaddressed in the implementation plan.

FR-007 requires validating parser precision (≥0.85) and recall (≥0.80) against a gold standard. While T015 loads the gold standard and T016 checks correlation (r ≥ 0.6), there is no explicit task to calculate precision/recall metrics for edge detection as required by FR-007. T016 only checks Pearson correlation of depth scores, not parser structural accuracy.

FR-004 (Spec) mandates a two-way ANOVA, while Plan.md deviates to LMM. T035a implements LMM, but there is no task to perform the required power analysis justification (e.g., using statsmodels.stats.power) to scientifically validate this deviation before execution, as noted in the Analyze Report.

FR-006 requires validating that the test set is distinct from the training set. While T017 excludes invalid traces, there is no task to explicitly split the dataset into training (for DAG construction) and test (for accuracy) sets and verify their disjointness, leaving FR-006 unimplemented.
